jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Sea Container Transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

You will transport sea containers on dedicated shuttle and short-haul routes between the major port terminals and various warehouses throughout the Port of Antwerp.

As the majority of your work involves local shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals, you can avoid long motorway traffic jams while keeping your schedule tight, efficient, and predictable.

You will work confidently with the various terminal systems and carefully check all container and seal numbers to ensure everything is correct.

Thanks to flexible departure locations, you can also avoid unnecessary commuting time. In consultation with the planning team, you can start from a strategic location in the port that is most convenient for you.

An average working day is approximately 12 hours. However, if you prefer a better work-life balance, a 4/5 employment arrangement or part-time schedule is absolutely negotiable.

You will join a stable, permanent position with a clear focus on reliable, long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Qualifications: You hold a valid CE driving licence and an up-to-date Code 95 qualification.
    
• Language skills: You speak and understand Dutch or English well enough to communicate smoothly and effectively.
    
• Administration: You ensure the accurate and correct handling of CMR consignment notes and terminal documentation.
    
• Professional attitude: You are a serious, reliable professional who always works in a customer-friendly and presentable manner.

This is a job posting intended to create a reserve pool of candidates.

Are you looking for a job as a Payroll & Benefits Officer in Tienen? Combine payroll, benefits administration, HR support, and process improvement within an international organization. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, you play a key role within the HR team. You ensure employees receive accurate payroll processing and professional support regarding their benefits package. At the same time, you actively contribute to improving HR processes and systems.
 

This is a varied position where you combine administrative accuracy with employee interaction and collaboration with international colleagues.
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing payroll processing for employees in Belgium and gradually supporting payroll activities in other European countries.
 
• Administering a range of employee benefits, including company cars, insurance plans, pension schemes, and mobility solutions.
 
• Contributing to the optimization of payroll and HR processes and proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
 
• Ensuring the accurate registration and maintenance of employee data and HR records.
 
• Acting as the main point of contact for employees and managers regarding payroll and benefits-related questions. 
 

In addition, you work closely with payroll providers, insurance partners, and internal stakeholders. You also support reporting activities related to absenteeism, employee turnover, and other HR metrics.

 

For this Payroll & Benefits Officer position, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with figures, processes, and people. You are accurate, communicative, and thrive in an international environment.
 

You bring:
 

 
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent experience.
 
• Experience in payroll, HR administration, or a similar role.
 
• An excellent command of English. Knowledge of Dutch, French, or other European languages is a strong asset.
 
• Solid MS Office skills. Experience with Workday and/or SD Worx is considered a plus.
 
• A proactive, customer-oriented, and communicative personality. 
 

In addition, you have a strong analytical mindset, enjoy working with data, and pay close attention to detail. This enables you to maintain an overview, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.

jobs.description:

🎾 Play with tenacity You are results driven and KPI focused. You translate targets into concrete actions and follow through with discipline and consistency.

• Competitive salary with performance based bonus
• Generous employee discount on their collections

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Antwerp and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!
